_status: SYNTHETIC - values below are illustrative only

forecast_avalanche_problems.name: Persistent Slab
forecast_avalanche_problems.discussion: A persistent weak layer buried in late January continues to produce large avalanches on north through east facing slopes above 2400 m. Recent loading has added stress to this layer. Avoid steep, wind-loaded terrain on these aspects.

forecast_avalanche_problems.name: Wind Slab
forecast_avalanche_problems.discussion: Fresh wind slabs formed overnight on lee aspects near and above treeline.
